lines.1: 「Don't get too carried away in the aquarium, you two.」
lines.2: Still, we weren't going to fight in front of Otome.
lines.6: 「Doesn't seeing a school of fish make you hungry?」
lines.8: 「Oh, an octopus. Octopus is great with soy sauce and wasabi.」
lines.9: 「Look, Leo! That's what the underside of a ray looks like!」
lines.10: 「Oh, what's that fish? That's unusual! I wonder if it tastes good.」
lines.11: Otome was having the time of her life.
lines.12: A tuna swam leisurely past us.
lines.13: 「A fish that dies if it ever stops swimming, huh.」
lines.16: 「There's a failed-care story written right here.」
lines.18: 「It says tuna have to keep swimming, so some of them built up too much speed, slammed into the wall, and died.」
lines.19: 「That's reckless beyond belief. Sounds just like you.」
lines.20: 「You little... You really know how to get on my nerves.」
lines.21: 「Hmph. Then you're that one over there.」
lines.26: 「You're one completely ordinary fish in that crowd.」
lines.27: 「You never let yourself get swept up in excitement. You always match the people around you.」
lines.28: 「Perfect for a guy whose goal is to have no personality! Ahaha!」
lines.31: For some reason, the twin-tail looked a little pleased.
lines.32: ...Right. There was no point letting her bait me.
